maria: FYI I opened a docs PR to add per-route isolation decorators + SLA wording + examples for Dedicated -> Private migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421

dan: Nice. Can you include a short SDK snippet (py/go) showing how to set route isolation labels and SLA hint? Our customers ask for per-route SLO right now.

maria: Yep, adding both. Draft snippets below. Also adding a terraform rollback example for reserved capacity.

maria: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
route = client.routes.create(name="billing-inference", model="rw-large-v1", isolation_labels={"team":"billing","sensitivity":"pii"}, latency_slo_ms=120)
print(route.id)
```

dan: Maybe use `latency_slo_ms` -> good call on explicitness.

maria: changed to `latency_slo_ms` in the snippet.

jeff: For the terraform example include the reservation rollback example if capacity commit fails during migration. Small snippet:

maria: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_capacity" "billing" {
  name = "billing-pool"
  gpus = 4
  region = "us-west-2"
  isolation = true
}

# rollback hook (example)
resource "null_resource" "rollback" {
  triggers = {
    commit_status = redwood_reserved_capacity.billing.status
  }
  provisioner "local-exec" {
    when    = "create"
    command = "if [ \"${self.triggers.commit_status}\" != \"COMMITTED\" ]; then terraform destroy -target=redwood_reserved_capacity.billing -auto-approve; fi"
  }
}
```

anita: Do we need guidance for canary/runbook? docs should suggest a canary traffic split and automatic fallback to hosted model if Dedicated capacity isn't healthy.

maria: Good call. Adding short runbook steps and sample YAML for rollout policy: 

maria: ```yaml
rollout:
  canary: 10
  fallback:
    - model: rw-medium-v1
      priority: fallback-hosted
  health_checks:
    latency_threshold_ms: 250
    error_rate_threshold: 0.02
```

dan: Also flag that isolation_labels are for billing+network ACLs, but do not guarantee tenant-level cryptographic separation; mention KMS/HSM for that.
